Subject: Post-demo: multi-region perf targets & residency Qs

Thanks for the demo earlier — it was useful. A few follow-ups from our engineering and security teams so we can move toward procurement: 

1) Latency targets: for our customer-facing workflows we need p95 < 200ms for short prompts (~75 tokens) and p95 < 400ms for streaming chat sessions (typical chunk size 150 tokens). Are those achievable from US and EU regions?

2) Throughput/concurrency: our peak is ~1,200 concurrent chat connections with sustained 6 RPS per connection (bursty patterns during market open). What sizing do you recommend?

3) Data residency: EU customer data must remain in the EU — can the routing guarantees be pinned per tenant? Also, any SOC2 artifacts you can share?

4) Can you attach a sample traffic profile? Our infra team will share network constraints as well.

Next steps: if you can send a short post-call recap with proposed SLOs, a sizing matrix, and a list of evidence artifacts, we can loop in procurement.

Thanks,
Claire Williams
Director, Platform Engineering
FinServCo

Quick technical readout / assumptions from infra:

Assumptions we used to build the sizing matrix:
- Short prompt profile: 75 tokens in, ~30 tokens out avg. Streaming chunks ~150 tokens at ~40ms generate per chunk on A100-style hw (single-request path).
- Concurrency: 1,200 sockets with ~6 RPS each => gross 7,200 RPS. After batching and prefix caching we estimate effective token-gen concurrency lowers by ~3–4x depending on locality.
- Latency: For US-only, p95 ~120–180ms (short prompts) on medium instance pools; EU adds +20–45ms depending on region egress; APAC adds larger delta depending on POP.

Constraints / clarifying asks for FinServCo ops:
- Do you require strict in-region egress for logs/telemetry? Our private deployments can vend logs to a customer-owned KMS and S3 in-region; hosted will need contract-level assurance.
- Are you planning to pin specific tenants to dedicated capacity or prefer routing with guaranteed residency? Dedicated capacity enables tighter p95 targets but requires a commit.

Attachments requested from FinServCo (to validate sizing):
- sample_traffic_profile.json (please include timestamped RPS and payload sizes)
- any firewall / IP allowlist requirements

Internal action:
- Hannah: run a quick simulation with these numbers on our staging clusters and confirm whether we need to recommend dedicated pools for the market-open burst.

Marcus Lin
Staff SWE, Inference Runtime
